name: projection_stack_m128_pooler_alt_v1
hypothesis: Retain the full promoted descriptor stack and change only the M128 pooler cuBLASLt descriptor diag field from 4 to the distinct search seed 0. This isolates the M128 pooler plan, whose 19.8us verify-16 GEMM has not been individually confirmed.
decision_reason: Official H200 check passed all 9 correctness tests but scored 1.50688x (95% CI [1.48427, 1.52948]), below the promoted 1.53456x. The target M128 pooler profile was 20.9us versus 19.8us for the promoted descriptor; reject and preserve the canonical plan.
